intent.problem_statement: Implement Modul 2 (Magic Sync & User Data) focusing on SSOT Management, Stripe Integration (Pay-later), and Mock Sync Visualization.
success_metrics: User can edit their 'Master Profile' with zero friction
Stripe checkout triggers at the peak of 'Value Delivery'
Mock sync provides immediate visual satisfaction

constraints.performance_requirements: Sync state must be persistent and reflected in the UI in near real-time.
limitations: No real OAuth for now (Mock Sync)
Single-user context for MVP (no multi-location / franchise support yet)

entities: Profile (Master Data: Name, Address, Phone, Hours)
logic_flows: Audit -> Email Entry -> Profile Creation (Auto-populated from Audit)
Sync Trigger -> Stripe Checkout -> Webhook -> Mock Sync Start

decisions.resolution: Option B (Success Preview). Wir simulieren die ersten 90% des Syncs, bevor Stripe zur finalen Freischaltung eingeblendet wird.
Option B (Action-Based). Änderungen im Profil erzeugen neue Tasks in der Action Inbox für volle Kontrolle.
Option B (Shadow Profile). Nutzer editiert anonym, Registrierung erst beim finalen Sync-Trigger.
Option A (Command Center). Kombination aus Plattform-Kacheln und technischem Live-Log für maximale 'Authority'.
